schema: semantic_commit_v12 unchanged; prompt clarifies available proof without relabeling unknown time
method: Exact saved audit replay plus labelled real-producer boundary worlds; no new model or campaign write.
retained: Explicit checkpoint and ordered handoff rules
producer_controls: Visible A-to-B-to-A cannot certify equal endpoints.
Hidden round trip loses certification even with no public transitions.
Visibility loss/restoration and missing/hidden custody lose certification.
First placement and recorded materialization cannot certify initial-to-final continuity.
Hidden duplicate canonical holders reject packet construction.
polarity: A unique certificate for A supports positive A and negative distinct B; contradicts negative A and positive B. Missing/ambiguous certificate proves neither.
reconstruction_limit: Producer reconstruction differs in unrelated resource-scope metadata; original audit packets/responses themselves are replayed unchanged.
limitations: Only an unspecified point within the current primary turn is resolved; not unknown identity, prior/future history, ownership or permission.
No retroactive commit or new successful playthrough.
Model semantic classification and extraction remain probabilistic.
